comment: The ticket standard (vdb-site docs/factory.md 2.9.1). vdb-site factoryTicketIssues and belai internal/ticketrules.Check must return these codes, in this order, for each case. Copy changes to belai internal/ticketrules/testdata/ticket-standard.golden.json.

cases.name: a complete ticket
cases.title: Rotate the Stripe key committed in billing/config.ts
cases.body:
## User story
As the billing service maintainer, I want the exposed key replaced, so that nobody holding it can create charges.

## Context
secret_scanning_alert #41, reported active by GitHub.

## Success criteria
- Given the old key, when it calls the API, then it is refused.
- The service reads the new key from the vault.

## Definition of done
The organisation's list.

## Todo
- [ ] Confirm the key is live
- [ ] Roll the key
- [ ] Replace the literal with a vault read

## Out of scope
Other keys in the repository.
